acceptedFindings.rationale: Debian classifies this as a no-DSA minor issue. The vulnerable native scanf %mc path with an explicit oversized width is not invoked by Academy's Python processes; ingress TLS terminates at ALB. Keep exact package-version matching until Debian publishes a stable fix.

Debian classifies this malformed GDBus introspection-XML out-of-bounds read as a no-DSA minor issue and has no stable fix. GLib is retained only as a mandatory tesseract-ocr dependency in the API, AI, and Tools OCR runtimes; Academy invokes neither g_dbus_node_info_new_for_xml nor D-Bus introspection XML. Keep exact repository and package-version matching until Debian publishes a stable fix.
